content: In 1980 a misplaced oil drill at Lake Peigneur in Louisiana broke into a salt mine, and the lake drained down into it.
evidence: Lake Peigneur in Louisiana drains into an underlying salt deposit. A misplaced Texaco oil probe had been drilled into the Diamond Crystal Salt Mine, causing water to flow down into the mine, eroding the edges of the hole.
